business_question: When did complete-month Product GMV peak?
finding_statement: Among calendar-complete months, 2017-11-01 had the highest observed Product GMV at BRL 1,003,862.14.
limitation: Boundary months excluded; descriptive observation window.

business_question: How prevalent was observed repeat purchasing?
finding_statement: 92,099 of 94,986 commercial customers placed exactly one eligible order; the governed observed repeat rate was 3.04%.
limitation: Not retention or lifetime behavior; unequal exposure.

business_question: How concentrated was category Product GMV?
finding_statement: health_beauty ranked first by eligible Product GMV at BRL 1,255,695.13; the top five categories represented 39.82% of eligible Product GMV.

business_question: How concentrated was seller Product GMV?
finding_statement: The leading seller represented 1.70% of eligible Product GMV, while the top ten represented 13.20%.
limitation: Concentration does not establish dependency or market power; no best/worst claim.

finding_statement: Across 96,470 endpoint-qualified delivered orders, average lead time was 12.56 days and 8.11% arrived after estimate.

business_question: Are late deliveries associated with review scores?
finding_statement: Reviewed late orders averaged 2.57, versus 4.29 for reviewed on-time orders, an observed difference of -1.73 points.
population: endpoint-qualified delivered orders with reviewed subsets
denominator: late eligible=7826; late reviewed=7661; on-time eligible=88644; on-time reviewed=88163
numerical_evidence: late eligible=7826; late reviewed=7661; late mean=2.566505678109907; on-time eligible=88644; on-time reviewed=88163; on-time mean=4.294292012144172
limitation: Observed association; does not establish causality.

business_question: Which Customer State had the largest observed commercial value?
finding_statement: Customer State SP had the largest eligible Product GMV at BRL 5,163,867.22, across 41,126 commercial orders.
population: commercial orders by order-associated Customer State
limitation: Order-associated geography is not permanent customer residence.

business_question: Which recorded payment type dominated value?
finding_statement: credit_card represented 78.34% of Recorded Payment Value across 76,795 payment records.
limitation: Recorded Payment Value is not revenue, cash received, or net sales.
